insights.one_liner: Parakar is a 72-person Breda firm handling HR, payroll and work permits for international companies, and itself an IND visa sponsor.

culture.text: An employment services firm in Breda doing outsourced HR, payroll, work permits and relocation for companies expanding into Europe.
Small team of 72 on LinkedIn; staff often studied HR, business or international studies at Avans, Tilburg, BUas or Erasmus.
Founded in the Netherlands in 2001 by Johan Opperman.

open.text: Parakar Group B.V., Parakar Consulting B.V. and Parakar Netherlands B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Its whole business is helping people work across borders, including work permit and relocation services.
